Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and in line with data protection principles. Organizational and time‑management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple cases simultaneously. Attention to detail and accuracy in data entry, documentation and record‑keeping. Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment and adapt to diverse operational contexts. Problem‑solving skills and the ability to identify issues and propose practical solutions. Ability to work independently with limited supervision, as well as collaboratively within a team. Basic analytical skills to compile information, identify trends and prepare routine reports. Flexibility and willingness to conduct field work, including visits to external facilities when required. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 1 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Provide co-workers with information about hazards, risks and risk mitigation measures applicable to the site. Ensuring within the scope of the discipline works that subcontractors are in compliance with the EHS requirements at the site. Job Description Roles and Responsibilities The role requires strong mechanical execution and site-management capability, including subcontractor/client management, claims, rental equipment and company assets, EHS reviews, site warehouse / material controls, financials and statutory compliance. The incumbent will also lead the mechanical construction team / Supervisors to deliver project targets. Main Tasks The Mechanical Construction Manager is responsible for the performance of site activities within the scope of his field of expertise, which is mainly the rotating machines erection, maintenance, alignment, over-hauling, repair, trouble shooting, etc. Checking the assembly documentation for his mechanical equipment scope, as well as the O&M manuals. Checking the I&T plans for his field of expertise while including the I&T program. Full supervision, support and guidance of the team working under his authority Full erection and maintenance of Rotating machines in accordance with the applicable drawings ,and O & M manuals. Full implementation of EHS rules and directives. Full cooperation and coordination with SM and other supervisors . Implementation of the work schedule tasks and time lines. Detailed Tasks Perform erection and maintenance of all pumps in Turbine hall such as Feedwater pumps, condensate extraction pumps, CCW pumps, ACW pumps, miscellaneous pumps, etc Perform erection and maintenance of all blowers, compressors, fans, and control valves. Perform all shaft / rotors alignments , and keep records according to ITPL Oversees assigned mechanical personnel and daily erection activities (e.g. training, scheduling, etc.) for the purpose of ensuring that assignments are completed in a safe, proper and timely manner and maximizing the efficiency of the workforce Prepare and brief his team on individual site jobs to ensure site work is carried out to a high standard. Ability in reading and understanding specifications, drawings, and all other related project and engineering documentation. Knowledge of power plant KKS system is an added advantage. Maintenance , over-haul , and repairs of mechanical systems like actuators, pumps, motors, valves, hydraulics, pneumatics, upon request of GEV commissioning, and erection lead. Walk downs and visual inspection of live systems while plant in operation. Equipment malfunctions, faults, leaks, noise, etc and reporting to the related responsible. Commissioning assistance for cleaning preparation, inspection, tools, and spare parts. Checking of availability of tools required for erection and maintenance. Keeps records of all work completed and completion of "Action Lists" Must be a good communicator. Able to give instructions in an efficient and effective way to his workforce. Liaises with other discipline foremen to ensure the optimum utilization of available work, with the overall objective of successful completion of the project. Familiar with all Company Safety and QA/QC procedures and strictly enforces them amongst the GEV / subcontractor workforce. Identifies, formulates and implements "on - the - job" training programs for the workforce under his responsibility in coordination with the supervisor. Supervise and/or perform mechanical tasks related to disassembly & reassembly, functional clearance checks , alignment check of all rotating equipment and including turbine shaft line. Ability to use and train his team on all type of accurate measurement tools. Ensure work permits and checks are completed to carry work out safely.
